script: Stop calling her dear if you're over forty. These three nicknames make a grown woman blush. Most men get stuck on hey babe or sweetheart. She hears I'm on call, not a date. One: her full name, said slowly, like you mean it. Two: the trouble, with a smile. Would you be up to mischief? Grown women don't want sweet. They want seen.
